_comment: GOVERNED-SURFACE PIN — the reviewable record of WHAT WAS PRE-SIGNED.
This file is DATA, not a decision. It does not sign anything and it is not
itself a HITL sign-off: it records the exact content that an already-given
HITL pre-sign was keyed to, so that scripts/check-governed-surface-pin.sh can
make that pin mechanical instead of remembered.
WHAT WAS PRE-SIGNED: the accumulated governed-surface delta of 0.8.20 Slices
5d + 10b + 15b + 15d (AC-079), then the Slice 60 nested-projection search
delta as SIGNED by the HITL on 2026-08-05. The exact pinned content has
32 allowlist members, 5 core, and recovery_denylist unchanged at the five
REQ-054 names (the 'recovery denylist is five names' rule, AC-041).
WHY THE FULL MEMBER LISTS ARE COPIED HERE and not just a hash: a reviewer
must be able to SEE what was signed. A bare hash is unreviewable — nobody can
tell from 93ef3a86... whether `purge` was in the signed surface. Copying the
members also makes a lazy re-pin visible: updating only `sha256` to silence
the gate still fails, because the gate compares the member lists too.
WHY THIS PIN EXISTS AT ALL: it is what lets 0.8.20 Slices 20 / 25 / 30
proceed WITHOUT stopping for a per-slice HITL sign-off. The pre-sign covers
exactly the content named here, so any divergence necessarily re-opens it.
Slice 20 is EXPECTED to trip the gate; tripping is CORRECT BEHAVIOUR.
HOW TO CHANGE THIS FILE: only in the SAME change that carries the new
governed surface, and only AFTER the HITL has signed that new surface.
Re-pinning to make the gate green is the exact failure mode the gate exists
to prevent.
RE-ISSUED 2026-07-29 (steward seq-157 / TC-52). The batched governed-surface
decision was SIGNED, so the four `AWAITING HITL SIGN-OFF, NOT SIGNED` markers
in the pinned file's `_comment` were corrected to record the signature. The
gate hashes RAW BYTES, so that prose fix necessarily moved both hashes and the
pin had to be re-issued in the SAME commit. THE SIGNED SURFACE DID NOT CHANGE:
allowlist/core/recovery_denylist are byte-for-byte the members below, still
30 / 5 / 5, denylist still the five REQ-054 names. This is a PROSE re-pin under
a given signature, NOT a re-pin to silence a tripped gate — the gate was green
(exit 0) immediately before and after.
